basic_info.description: Welcome to One Steuart Lane - a refined living experience along San Francisco's iconic waterfront.    Residence 1005 features interiors curated by the internationally acclaimed architecture firm Skidmore, Owings & Merrill. This stunning home is bathed in natural light through expansive floor-to-ceiling windows and features European oak flooring, elegant marble finishes, and meticulous detailing throughout.  The gourmet kitchen is a chef's dream, outfitted with Gaggenau appliances, including a sleek touch-to-open refrigerator and freezer, a remote powered vented hood fan, and a built-in wine cooler for effortless entertaining.    Retreat to the serene primary bathroom, where a dramatic marble feature wall, ambient cove lighting, and premium Dornbracht fixtures create a spa-like atmosphere.  World-class amenities include valet parking, a 24-hour attended lobby with porter service, and a beautifully designed Residents' Lounge with a full kitchen and waterfront terrace. Rejuvenate in the Wellness Center, featuring a state-of-the-art workout facility, pilates studio, steam and sauna rooms, vertical experiential showers, and an outdoor hot tub overlooking the Bay.  One Steuart Lane is truly the height of luxury living.  *please note some photos are virtually staged.
